description: This is a Python source file defining the CloudZeroLogger class, which handles exporting usage data to CloudZero's API. It includes methods for initializing exports, performing hourly data exports, dry runs, and displaying data in a formatted manner. The class also sets up a background job for regular exports.

classes.name: CloudZeroLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for exporting usage data to CloudZero's AnyCost API, with methods for exporting, dry running, and displaying formatted data.

methods.name: initialize_cloudzero_export_job(self)
methods.description: Handles the scheduled export job, ensuring only one pod performs the export at a time using a lock.

methods.name: _hourly_usage_data_export(self)
methods.description: Exports the hourly usage data to CloudZero, considering a time range of the last two hours.

methods.name: export_usage_data( self, limit: Optional[int] = None, operation: str = "replace_hourly", start_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, end_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Performs the data export by loading data from the database, transforming it, and sending it to CloudZero.

methods.name: dry_run_export_usage_data(self, limit: Optional[int] = 10000)
methods.description: Performs a dry run that returns the data that would be exported, without actually sending it, including summary statistics.

methods.description: Displays the transformed CBF data in a formatted table in the console.

methods.name: init_cloudzero_background_job(scheduler: AsyncIOScheduler)
methods.description: Sets up a background job to periodically export data to CloudZero.
